style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice-white background #F2F8FC, ice-blue primary #A9D6E9, deep ocean blue text #1F5D8C and one bright accent blue #4AA3D8; bright soft studio lighting with a front-top cool key, crisp water highlights and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep ocean blue with accent-blue rounded badges and small occasion chips; consistent rounded rectangular info cards with thin-line check icons; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the pouch stack; pouches always shown plump and sealed, sheet texture shown via macros only; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: wet-look water surface #BFE0F0 and clean ice-blue gradient boards #D6EBF7, neutral grey fabric backdrop #C9D3DA for fiber macros
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep ocean blue #1F5D8C with short sub-lines and labels, all copy wrapped in 「」; accent blue #4AA3D8 reserved for rounded badges and small occasion chips
